title: Inter's press scorecard: 14 paper claims this week, only 3 held up
description:
Inter's papers printed 14 claims this week. Three held up, one was wrong, ten are still open.
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=54

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

DENIED - Gazzetta dello Sport (Oct 19): Ivan Provedel would make his Inter debut against Shakhtar. Josep Martinez started and made three saves (Inter.it, Oct 21).
CONFIRMED - Sky Sport Italia (Oct 21): Maurizio Mariani would referee Inter vs Fiorentina. Inter.it's matchday guide named him on Oct 23.
CONFIRMED - Corriere dello Sport (Oct 22): Lautaro Martinez out for Fiorentina and Venezia. Inter.it still has him out on Oct 25.
CONFIRMED - Corriere dello Sport and Gazzetta dello Sport (Oct 21): Josep Martinez keeps the goalkeeper's place against Shakhtar. Inter.it carried his post-match quotes on Oct 21.
STILL OPEN - Gazzetta dello Sport (Oct 23): Carlos Augusto's extension to 2031, "within fifteen days". Inter have published nothing.
